title: CONNECT-IP Target and Protocol Scope Policy Verification
verification_method: Focused unit tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, generated coverage triage, and diff hygiene for RFC 9484 target/ipproto scope policy.
scope: This verification covers IP-prefix single-version policy, scoped route advertisement filtering, specific and wildcard ipproto semantics, allowable next-header values, ICMP exception handling, Figure 6 target/ipproto grammar, percent-encoded IPv6 colons and prefix slashes, prefix length limits, zero host-bit enforcement, and client-scope access-control rejection.
preconditions: RFC 9484 URI Template expansion and CONNECT-IP request policy are implemented.
expected_result: The focused CONNECT-IP scope-policy tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9484 scope artifacts, generated triage reflects requirements 0065-0079 as trace-clean, and diff hygiene passes.
status_summary: The RFC 9484 target/ipproto scope policy surface is trace-owned and verified by focused local gates.
